resolved_findings.problem: Preserving time-of-day in the new start bound excluded Friday midnight-stamped daily bars for a Saturday lookback=1 request that previously included them.
resolved_findings.resolution: 47ad8c9 floors the UTC start to the beginning of the first calendar day; regressions exercise both public methods with a provider honoring both bounds. Latest-500 fixture also now honors both bounds.

resolved_findings.problem: Current-time end affects higher-timeframe callers and can select an evolving interval.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final report and task risks explicitly promise latest available data rather than closed intervals; this remains part of the activation/cohort decision.

resolved_findings.resolution: Final index and snapshot summary explicitly separate isolated test configuration, stopped original runtime and ephemeral candidate retrieval probe.

correctness_review: Both public historical methods share one request window, preserve feed and split adjustment, request descending data, follow continuation tokens until enough unique bars or no continuation, then expose the latest selected bars in chronological UTC order.

Request end is captured once. Page parameter dictionaries are copied, overlap deduplicates by normalized timestamp, page size is capped at 10000, repeated/invalid continuation and the 100-page bound fail closed. Page API errors do not return partial success.

Ambiguous, invalid and future timestamps cause retrieval failure. Prefill validates historical and retained-stream timestamps before publishing; a malformed result cannot partially replace its existing buffer or freshness metadata.

Prefill merge executes without an await after REST returns, preserving callbacks that arrived during the await and giving existing stream rows precedence on timestamp collisions. Historical-only age derives from the newest event; cross-symbol global age does not regress to the last stale symbol.

AST comparison confirms _prefill is the only changed StreamingDataProvider method. Stream callback receipt semantics, later callback ordering, stale thresholds, freeze-hashed functions, feed/config values and trading submission gates are unchanged.

No ML or Kelly influence is introduced into learning mode, no order-submission branch is added, and no frozen reference is restamped. Unchanged hashes do not establish equivalent input data or authorize activation.
